about: The dates before 1 March 1900, SUBSTITUTE's instances, and TEXT's General and empty code, as the seventeenth Windows run observed Excel to answer them (verification/2026-10-11-windows-17/), and serial 0 and 60 under EOMONTH and EDATE, and TEXT's General with a minus sign and under a lone @, as the area passes did (verification/2026-10-12-windows-area/ and -area-2/; ADR-0047, ADR-0120, ADR-0202). An Error Value written without refused is one a Formula catches. Transcribed from ExSheet.Engine.Tests' ObservedDatesAndTextTests.
